retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring figures in dark clothing against a bright, warm-toned backlit glow with expressive script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two figures in dark, textured clothing are positioned against a stark white background that transitions into a vibrant orange and yellow airbrushed glow at the bottom. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and bright highlights on hair and clothing textures. A large, fluid script logo dominates the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark silhouettes against a bright, warm-toned light source
Fluid, expressive script contrasting with rigid geometric poses
Textured highlights on hair and leather against flat white space
Vertical standing figure balanced by a low-angled reclining figure
coreInvariants: Warm orange-to-yellow gradient glow at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two human figures occupy the left and bottom-center; one standing vertically, one reclining horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large script logo in the top right provides a heavy visual weight to balance the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the standing figure's face, moves down her body to the reclining figure, and then sweeps up to the script logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper left and center creates a clean, graphic feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between black and white; high saturation in the warm accent glow.
paletteRestrictions: Monochrome base with warm fire-toned accents

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a brush or marker
Extended flourishes on the first and last characters
Sharp, angular terminals on the descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial capital letter is oversized and circular
The final letter features a long, diagonal underline flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale script paired with a tiny, ultra-wide tracked sans-serif for a high-fashion look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photo of two figures in 80s fashion (leather jackets, big hair) against a white background with a vibrant orange and yellow airbrushed glow at the bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, black fluid script logo in the top right with a thin yellow stroke, and a tiny, wide-tracked all-caps sans-serif subtitle along the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with bright highlights on hair?
Is the bottom glow a saturated orange/yellow gradient?
Is the script logo fluid and expressive?
Is the subtitle text tracked out significantly?

mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of the original artist name
Ensure the script is a unique vector path rather than a standard font

mustAchieve: Sharp photographic clarity in the highlights
Smooth airbrushed transition in the color glow

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast thresholding on the figures
Verify the script logo has a hand-drawn quality
Ensure the white background is clean and blown out
Confirm the warm glow is restricted to the lower third
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast figure + white negative space + bottom airbrush glow + expressive script logo = 80s Synth-Pop Aesthetic
